name: Turtle
intro: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell. Some turtles live in ponds. Tortoises are turtles that live on land.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A turtle has a hard shell.
The shell grows from its ribs.
A turtle has a hard beak, not teeth.
Many turtles can hide their heads in their shells.
A box turtle can close its shell almost all the way.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Turtles live almost all over the world.
Many turtles spend lots of time in water.
Tortoises are turtles that live on dry land.
Box turtles live in woods and fields near ponds.
Desert tortoises dig holes to stay cool.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Different turtles eat different foods.
Tortoises eat grass, flowers, fruit, and cactus.
Box turtles eat plants, fruit, mushrooms, and bugs.
Baby box turtles eat more bugs than plants.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother turtle digs a hole for her eggs.
A box turtle lays about 4 or 5 eggs.
She covers the eggs and leaves.
The babies hatch and take care of themselves.
Turtles grow slowly and live a long time.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Some tortoises live more than 100 years.
Box turtles rest all winter when it is cold.
A tortoise warms its body in the sun.
Other animals share the desert tortoise's hole.
Tortoises have lived on Earth since the dinosaurs.

vocab.meaning: An animal with scaly skin, like a turtle or a snake.
The hard cover that keeps a turtle safe.
A turtle that lives on land.
A baby animal that just came out of its egg.
